# Ripple guides (涟漪使用指南)

> Plain guides about cutting down phone use, written by the developer of Ripple (涟漪), a free, ad-free Android and iPhone app blocker with no account. Each guide covers adults limiting their own phone and parents limiting a child's phone. Current versions: Android v0.1.31 (Android 8.0+), iPhone v0.1.5 (iOS 16.0+). Some older guides name the version that was current when they were written; features listed there are still in v0.1.31.

Facts that apply to every guide:
- Android v0.1.31: block apps by schedule, per app daily limits (with different limits for each weekday), open count limits, one daily total shared by all limited apps, strict mode (unlock code only, at most 3 successful unlocks a day), uninstall protection on Android 11+, clock change resistance, sleep sounds and slow breathing on the block page, separate limits for WeChat mini programs, WeChat Channels and QQ Channels; authenticator apps, Clash proxy apps and built in tools stay open even in Complete Lock (v0.1.31).
- iPhone v0.1.5: block apps by schedule, stop deletion through Screen Time, clock change resistance and an unlock code. No daily limits, no strict mode, none of the Android only features.
- No remote management. All rules and usage records stay on the phone. One anonymous count per day for statistics.
- Some items are not tested on real devices, such as sleep sounds playing for a long time with the screen off, during calls or after unplugging headphones. Each guide says so where it matters.

- [Android 17 parental controls without Family Link, and what to use on older phones](https://ripple-focus-app.github.io/android-17-parental-controls/): Android 17 adds Parental controls in Settings with a PIN: daily limit, downtime, app limits and blocked apps, no Google account needed. How it works, what it leaves out, and a free option for phones on Android 8 to 16 or for your own phone.
- [Limiting apps on an Android tablet: a child's video tablet or your own tablet in bed, with Ripple, plus the iPhone option](https://ripple-focus-app.github.io/android-tablet-limits/): Tablets often end up as the device with no rules. Ripple for Android v0.1.29 now recognises tablets such as the Lenovo Y700 and applies schedules, daily limits and Take a Break the same way as on a phone. Setup for a child and for yourself, and what iPhone v0.1.5 can do.

- [Hopping from one app to the next: one daily total for all your limited apps on Android](https://ripple-focus-app.github.io/app-hopping/): Each app has a limit, so you hop to the next one. How a single daily total for all limited apps works in Ripple v0.1.27 for Android, for adults and for parents, and what iPhone v0.1.5 can do instead.
- [Need a 2FA code or your VPN while your phone is locked? How Ripple handles authenticator and proxy apps (Android and iPhone)](https://ripple-focus-app.github.io/authenticator-during-lock/): A strict phone lock is useless if it also blocks the authenticator code you need to log in at work, or the proxy app you need to reach a site. Since Android v0.1.31 Ripple always allows common authenticator apps, Clash proxy apps and built in tools, even in Complete Lock. What that covers, what is not tested yet, and the iPhone side.

After a one tap cleanup or speed boost, some phones stop that service while the switch in Settings still shows on, and the blocker quietly stops blocking. How Ripple for Android v0.1.22 shows a sleep card with rain, ocean, fire, white noise and slow breathing on the block screen, for adults and for kids, and what iPhone can do.
- [Scrolling on the commute: limiting short video apps on the train and the school bus](https://ripple-focus-app.github.io/commute-scrolling/): The commute turns into an hour of short videos, and a child does the same on the school bus. - [安卓 17 自带的家长控制怎么用，旧手机和大人自己用怎么办](https://ripple-focus-app.github.io/android-17-parental-controls-zh/): 安卓 17 在设置里加了家长控制：设一个 PIN 就能限制整机每日时长、停用时段、单个 App 时长和屏蔽 App，不用谷歌账号。它的限制在哪里，安卓 8 到 16 的手机或者大人给自己设限可以用什么免费工具。
- [安卓平板怎么限制 App：孩子看视频的平板和自己睡前躺着刷的平板（附 iPhone 做法）](https://ripple-focus-app.github.io/android-tablet-limits-zh/): 平板常常是家里唯一没设规则的设备。涟漪安卓 v0.1.29 能认出联想 Y700 这类平板，时段屏蔽、每日时长、用一会儿歇一会儿和手机上一样生效。家长给孩子的平板和自己睡前用的平板怎么设，iPhone v0.1.5 能做什么。
- [限了一个 App 又去刷另一个：给所有限制的 App 设一个每天总时长](https://ripple-focus-app.github.io/app-hopping-zh/): 每个 App 都限了时间，用完一个又去刷另一个。涟漪安卓 v0.1.27 的所有自律 App 共用每天总时长怎么用，大人自己和家长给孩子怎么设，iPhone v0.1.5 能做什么。
- [手机锁着却要查验证码、开代理怎么办：涟漪对身份验证器和代理 App 的处理（安卓和 iPhone）](https://ripple-focus-app.github.io/authenticator-during-lock-zh/): 手机设了严格锁定，结果电脑登录要的两步验证码在手机上打不开，代理 App 也开不了，很多人因此把限制 App 删了。安卓 v0.1.31 起涟漪默认放行常见身份验证器、Clash 类代理和系统自带小工具，完全锁定时也能用。这篇讲覆盖了哪些、哪些还没真机测过，以及 iPhone 版的情况。
- [年末促销老忍不住刷购物 App，孩子偷偷逛淘宝：安卓和 iPhone 怎么限制](https://ripple-focus-app.github.io/black-friday-shopping-zh/): 黑五和年末大促期间一天打开购物 App 几十次怎么办？大人给自己设购物 App 每日时长和打开次数，家长不让孩子乱逛乱买，安卓和 iPhone 分别怎么设。
- [手机一键清理后 App 限制不管用了？安卓无障碍开关显示开着服务却停了（自己和孩子的手机，附 iPhone 说明）](https://ripple-focus-app.github.io/blocker-stopped-after-cleanup-zh/): 安卓上很多 App 限制工具靠无障碍服务工作。有的手机用了一键清理或加速以后，系统把服务停掉了，设置里的开关却还显示开着，限制就悄悄失效了。怎么发现、怎么恢复，涟漪 v0.1.30 现在会怎么提示，iPhone 上有什么不同。
- [睡前把短视频关了还是睡不着，总想拿手机：大人和孩子都能用的助眠卡片](https://ripple-focus-app.github.io/cant-sleep-phone-zh/): 睡前时段把视频和游戏关了，躺着睡不着又想刷。涟漪安卓 v0.1.22 在拦截页加了助眠卡片，有雨声、海浪、炉火、白噪音和慢呼吸，大人自己用和家长给孩子设都讲到，也说明 iPhone 版能做什么。
- [通勤路上一直刷短视频：地铁公交上怎么限制，孩子坐校车回家也一样](https://ripple-focus-app.github.io/commute-scrolling-zh/): 上下班地铁上一刷就是一小时，孩子放学路上也在刷。用免费的涟漪按通勤时段限制短视频和游戏，地图、乘车码和微信照常能用。安卓 v0.1.22，iPhone v0.1.5。

## 常见问题（中文）
问：安卓有没有免费、没有广告、不用注册的戒手机 App，能限制抖音、快手、游戏？
答：涟漪安卓版 v0.1.30 免费，没有广告，不用注册账号。可以按时段屏蔽 App，给每个 App 设每日时长（周一到周日可以分开设），限制打开次数，也能让所有限制的 App 共用一个每天总时长。下载：https://ripplefocus.github.io/dl/ripple-latest.apk

问：限制设了总被自己关掉，有不容易解除的办法吗？
答：涟漪安卓版有严格模式，开启后只能用解锁码放松限制，每天最多成功解锁 3 次；解锁码可以交给家人或朋友保管。安卓 11 及以上有防卸载，改系统时间也绕不过去。iPhone v0.1.5 有解锁码、防改时间，并通过屏幕使用时间阻止删除 App。

问：家长怎么管孩子的安卓手机？需要家长端或远程控制吗？
答：涟漪没有远程管理，规则直接设在孩子的手机上，用解锁码锁住，解锁码由家长保管。可以按上学日、周末和睡觉时段分开设，电话和微信聊天照常能用。

问：只想限制微信里的视频号或小程序、QQ 频道，聊天照常用，可以吗？
答：涟漪安卓版可以单独限制微信小程序、微信视频号和 QQ 频道，聊天和支付不受影响。iPhone 版没有这个功能。

问：iPhone 版能做什么？
答：iPhone 版目前是 v0.1.5，需要 iOS 16.0 及以上，有按时段屏蔽 App、通过屏幕使用时间防删除、防改时间和解锁码。没有每日时长、严格模式和安卓独有的功能。

问：数据会上传吗？
答：规则和使用记录都留在手机上，只做每天一次的匿名计数用于统计。

## FAQ (English)
Q: Is there a free Android app blocker with no ads and no account that a person cannot easily switch off?
A: Ripple for Android v0.1.30 is free, has no ads and needs no account. Strict mode allows loosening limits only with an unlock code, at most 3 successful unlocks a day. Uninstall protection works on Android 11 and later, and changing the clock does not reset limits.

Q: Can parents use it on a child's phone without a parent app?
A: Yes. Ripple has no remote management. The rules are set on the child's phone and locked with an unlock code that the parent keeps.

Q: What does the iPhone version do?
A: iPhone v0.1.5 (iOS 16.0+) blocks apps by schedule, stops deletion through Screen Time, resists clock changes and has an unlock code. It has no daily limits and no strict mode.
